palette: deep navy, dusty blue, warm cream, awareness-ribbon red accent, soft teal for hope.

shots.prompt: A single red awareness ribbon floating above a sleeping city at night, soft red glow on the rooftops, deep navy sky with stars.
A cozy 1980s living room at night: an old box TV glows with a blank news-studio picture, a family on a patterned couch watching, retro wallpaper and a standing lamp.
An old brass pocket watch lying open on a hand-drawn map of central Africa without any labels, its hands blurred as if spinning backwards, warm light and dust in the air.
Dense tropical rainforest at dawn, mist between giant trees and vines, a chimpanzee sitting on a high branch calmly looking at the viewer.
Close-up of a hunter's hand with a small fresh cut on one finger, a single drop of blood falling onto a big jungle leaf, dark green tones.
Kinshasa in the 1920s: a growing river town on the wide Congo river, paddle steamboats at a wooden pier, a small steam train leaving along a new railway into the hills, warm evening light.
A vintage 1950s laboratory: glass test tubes with red blood samples in a wooden rack, an old brass microscope, a green desk lamp, blank labels.
Los Angeles in 1981 at dusk: palm trees and a hospital building, in the foreground a doctor's desk with an old typewriter and a short typed report with blank lines.
A dark room with a single file folder on a table under a hanging lamp, a blank silhouette photo clipped to it, long dramatic shadows.
Close-up of an old typed document on a desk with a big round circle drawn in the middle, a magnifying glass over it, dramatic side light, no readable letters.
A glowing DNA double helix rising above a dark ocean at night, a dotted travel line arcing from a small Caribbean island to a city skyline on the horizon.
A single white pill held between two fingers in front of a window with soft morning light, a calm bedroom, hopeful mood.
Two people holding hands walking in a sunny park, seen from behind, warm hopeful light, a small red ribbon pinned to one jacket.
A friendly doctor giving a small injection in the upper arm of a young adult in a bright modern clinic, a wall calendar with two days circled.
A huge crowd of diverse people seen from above filling a big city square, many of them holding small red ribbons.
A smiling grandmother with grey hair and round glasses sitting in an armchair with a cup of tea, a small red ribbon on her cardigan, cozy living room.
An evening city street corner with a blank arrow signpost pointing to the warmly lit door of a small clinic, inviting atmosphere.
